name: khfagy
description: A bright navy session HUD for Claude Code: live activity pane, turn summary, status line, alerts and guardrails for secrets and destructive commands. English and Arabic.

theme.title: Navy theme
theme.description: Apply the bright navy look in the desktop and mobile apps

guardSecrets.title: Protect secret files
guardSecrets.description: Block edits to .env files, private keys and credential files

guardCommands.title: Block destructive commands
guardCommands.description: Block rm -rf on the root or home folder and force pushes

slowTurnSeconds.title: Slow turn alert (seconds)
slowTurnSeconds.description: Show a toast when a turn takes longer than this. 0 turns it off.
